Eufloria — 'The Flower Lounge', a florist (2019).

A logo exploration built on a single recurring motif: a gilded ginkgo leaf. The routes paired the leaf with a clean monogram every way — inside a thin circle, behind a blackletter E, woven through an elegant script swash, framed by a gold bracket — to give a flower lounge a mark as considered as a bouquet.

Logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·65.
